basis: Conditional, source-linked procedural memory informed by the ACE structured-playbook approach; not the ACE framework or a reproduction of its published results.
learning_data: Exactly the shared 24 checked complete-spec training episodes; no validation or test prompts, answers or feedback enters curation.
candidate_budget: One hosted curation request, at most 2400 completion tokens, at most twelve bounded conditional notes. No retry or post-validation revision.
validation: Qualify once on all sixteen validation tasks, with the same frozen raw experience and two-call job allowance. Highest validation score selects the runtime policy; simpler wins ties.
frozen_test: All 112 selected fresh tasks remain, same exact external tests and per-job limits. GEPA is an explicitly identical-base alias, so three physically distinct policies are compared.
success: Playbook superiority requires positive paired accuracy differences against BOTH ordinary retrieval and the one-reflection learner, three-comparison-adjusted one-sided p<=.05, and no work family losing more than one task. All nulls and failures remain public.
promotion_after_qualification: Validation ties retain the existing runtime. A predeclared candidate may be promoted after the fixed fresh comparison only if it clears the corrected two-control superiority gate; no further prompt or skill revision is allowed on this cohort.
